I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled figure for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 261 seats. Ilse posted that in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel since changes it.

I couldn't check it against any Quarrendon account files, because none are visible to me in the share. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the team channel.
